Northern Wei.name: Yuan Hong
Northern Wei.title: Emperor Xiaowen
Northern Wei.note: Empress Dowager Feng ruled until 490; he moved the capital to Luoyang in 494.
Northern Wei.note_zh: 490年前冯太后临朝；494年迁都洛阳。

Northern Wei.name: Yuan Xiu
Northern Wei.title: Emperor Xiaowu
Northern Wei.note: Fled to Yuwen Tai in Chang'an; the empire split in two.
Northern Wei.note_zh: 西奔长安投宇文泰，北魏分裂。

Chouchi.name: Yang Nandang
Chouchi.title: Yang Nandang
Chouchi.note: Driven out by Liu Song in 442.

Liang.name: Xiao Fangzhi
Liang.title: Emperor Jing
Liang.note: Gave the throne to Chen Baxian.

Eastern Wei.name: Yuan Shanjian
Eastern Wei.title: Emperor Xiaojing
Eastern Wei.note: Gao Huan and then his son Gao Cheng held real power.
Eastern Wei.note_zh: 实权先后在高欢、高澄手中。

Western Liang.name: Xiao Cha
Western Liang.title: Emperor Xuan
Western Liang.note: A client state of Western Wei / Northern Zhou at Jiangling.
Western Liang.note_zh: 西魏、北周扶植的江陵附庸政权。

Northern Zhou.name: Yuwen Jue
Northern Zhou.title: Emperor Xiaomin
Northern Zhou.note: Yuwen Hu held real power until 572.

Northern Zhou.name: Yuwen Yong
Northern Zhou.title: Emperor Wu
Northern Zhou.note: Killed the regent Yuwen Hu in 572 and ruled himself.

Northern Zhou.name: Yuwen Chan
Northern Zhou.title: Emperor Jing
Northern Zhou.note: Yang Jian held power and founded Sui in 581.

Turks.name: Bumin
Turks.title: Illig Khagan
Turks.note: Founded the Turkic Khaganate by defeating the Rouran.
Turks.note_zh: 击败柔然，建立突厥汗国。

Ruanruan.name: Anagui
Ruanruan.title: Chiliantoubingdoufa Khagan
Ruanruan.note: Took his own life when the Turks defeated him in 552.

check.n: Reign end corrected from 424 to 426 per Wikipedia.
check.n_zh: 在位结束年据维基百科由424年更正为426年。

check.n: Reign start corrected from 424 to 426 per Wikipedia.
check.n_zh: 在位开始年据维基百科由424年更正为426年。

Tuyuhun.name: Murong Kualü
Tuyuhun.title: Kualü Khagan
Tuyuhun.note: First Tuyuhun ruler to take the title khagan.
Tuyuhun.note_zh: 吐谷浑首位称可汗的君主。

Yamato.name: Yūryaku
Yamato.title: Emperor Yūryaku
Yamato.note: Traditional dates. Probably King Bu (Wu) of Wa in Chinese records.
Yamato.note_zh: 传统纪年。可能即中国史书中的倭王武。

Van Xuan (Early Ly).name: Lý Bí
Van Xuan (Early Ly).title: Emperor Lý Nam
Van Xuan (Early Ly).note: Rose against Liang in 541; declared Van Xuan in 544.

yuanjia-campaign.note: Wei failed to take Xuyi and turned back; both sides were badly worn down.
yuanjia-campaign.note_zh: 北魏攻盱眙不下而北还，双方均损耗惨重。

sides.name: Liang
sides.troops_text: garrison of c. 3,000 plus relief armies

sides.name: Northern Wei
sides.troops_text: said to be several hundred thousand

zhongli.note: Rising river water helped Liang burn the Wei bridges.
zhongli.note_zh: 淮水暴涨，梁军乘势焚毁魏军浮桥。

sides.name: Northern Wei court and Erzhu Rong
Frontier rebels
sides.troops_text: Ge Rong's host was said to be a million

six-garrisons.note: The rebels were crushed by 528-530, but power passed to frontier generals and Wei split in 534.
six-garrisons.note_zh: 起义至528-530年被平定，但大权落入边将之手，北魏于534年分裂。

chen-qingzhi.note: Chen took Luoyang after winning dozens of battles, but Erzhu Rong soon drove him out and his army was lost.
chen-qingzhi.note_zh: 陈庆之连胜数十战入洛阳，但不久被尔朱荣击败，全军覆没。

shayuan.losses: Eastern Wei lost c. 80,000 men captured (reported)

yubi.note: Gao Huan dug tunnels and built siege mounds, but Wei Xiaokuan countered each one.
yubi.note_zh: 高欢挖地道、筑土山，均被韦孝宽一一破解。

sides.name: Hou Jing
sides.troops_text: c. 8,000 at the river crossing, growing later
sides.troops_text_zh: 渡江时约8千，后不断扩充

hou-jing.note: Hou Jing was finally beaten in 552 by Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian.
hou-jing.note_zh: 552年侯景最终被王僧辩、陈霸先击败。

jiangling-falls.losses: Tens of thousands of people taken north

prince-lanling.note: Also called the battle of Mangshan.

zhou-conquers-qi.note: Zhou took Pingyang and Jinyang in 576 and Ye in early 577.
zhou-conquers-qi.note_zh: 北周576年取平阳、晋阳，577年初攻克邺城。

routes.name: Northern Wei conquers Northern Liang
routes.summary: Emperor Taiwu marched west from Pingcheng to Guzang, ending the Sixteen Kingdoms; the path is approximate.
routes.summary_zh: 太武帝自平城西征姑臧，十六国时代结束；路线为大致示意。

routes.name: Northern Wei rides to the Yangtze
routes.summary: Answering Song's attack, Wei cavalry rode south to Guabu across the river from Jiankang; the path is simplified.
routes.summary_zh: 北魏反击刘宋北伐，骑兵直抵建康对岸的瓜步；路线为简化示意。

routes.name: Song Yun and Huisheng go west
routes.summary: Envoys of Northern Wei travelled through Tuyuhun and Khotan to Gandhara for Buddhist texts.
routes.summary_zh: 北魏使者宋云、惠生经吐谷浑、于阗前往乾陀罗求取佛经。

routes.name: Chen Qingzhi's march to Luoyang
routes.summary: Chen Qingzhi's white-robed army fought its way west and put Yuan Hao on the throne in Luoyang.
routes.summary_zh: 陈庆之白袍军一路西进，护送元颢入洛阳称帝。

routes.name: Hou Jing marches on Jiankang
routes.summary: Hou Jing rebelled at Shouyang, crossed the Yangtze and besieged the Liang capital.
routes.summary_zh: 侯景在寿阳起兵，渡江围攻梁都建康。

routes.name: Western Wei takes Jiangling
routes.summary: A Western Wei army marched south from Chang'an and captured the Liang capital at Jiangling.
routes.summary_zh: 西魏大军从长安南下，攻破梁都江陵。

routes.name: Northern Zhou conquers Northern Qi
routes.summary: Emperor Wu of Zhou crossed the Yellow River, took Pingyang and Jinyang, then captured Ye.
routes.summary_zh: 周武帝东渡黄河，攻取平阳、晋阳，再克邺城。

people.name: Xie Lingyun
people.known_for: Founder of Chinese landscape poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 中国山水诗的开创者。

works.title: Climbing the Tower by the Pond

people.line_zh: 池塘生春草，园柳变鸣禽。
people.line_en: Spring grass grows by the pond; in the garden willows, new birds sing.

people.name: Liu Yiqing
people.known_for: Liu Song prince who compiled anecdotes of Wei-Jin gentlemen.
people.known_for_zh: 刘宋宗室，编撰记载魏晋名士言行的笔记。

works.title: A New Account of the Tales of the World

people.name: Fan Ye
people.known_for: Wrote the history of the Eastern Han dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 撰写东汉一朝的正史。

people.name: Bao Zhao
people.known_for: Liu Song poet famed for his forceful ballads.
people.known_for_zh: 刘宋诗人，以雄健的乐府诗著称。

people.name: Fan Zhen
people.known_for: Argued that the soul dies with the body, against Buddhist teaching.
people.known_for_zh: 主张形亡则神灭，反对佛教的神不灭论。

works.title: On the Destructibility of the Soul

people.name: Tao Hongjing
people.known_for: Daoist master of the Shangqing school and pioneer of Chinese pharmacology.
people.known_for_zh: 道教上清派宗师，也是中国本草学的开拓者。

works.title: Collected Commentaries on the Classic of Materia Medica

people.name: Liu Xie
people.known_for: Wrote China's greatest work of literary criticism.
people.known_for_zh: 撰写中国最重要的文学理论著作。

works.title: The Literary Mind and the Carving of Dragons

people.name: Zhong Rong
people.known_for: Critic who ranked poets into three grades.
people.known_for_zh: 文学批评家，把历代诗人分为上中下三品。

people.name: Li Daoyuan
people.known_for: Northern Wei geographer who described over a thousand rivers.
people.known_for_zh: 北魏地理学家，记述了一千多条河流。

people.name: Paramartha
people.known_for: Indian monk who translated Yogacara texts in the south.
people.known_for_zh: 印度高僧，在南朝翻译瑜伽行派经论。

people.name: Xiao Tong
people.known_for: Liang crown prince who compiled the most influential anthology of early Chinese literature.
people.known_for_zh: 梁朝太子，编成影响最大的早期诗文总集。

people.name: Yu Xin
people.known_for: Southern poet held in the north who lamented the fall of Liang.
people.known_for_zh: 羁留北方的南朝诗人，作赋哀悼梁朝覆亡。

people.name: Tuoba Tao (Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei)
people.known_for: Northern Wei emperor who unified northern China in 439, ending the Sixteen Kingdoms period.
people.known_for_zh: 北魏太武帝，439年统一北方，结束十六国时代。

people.name: Cui Hao
people.known_for: Han Chinese chief adviser to Northern Wei emperors, executed over his frank state history.
people.known_for_zh: 北魏重臣、谋略家，因国史案被诛。

people.name: Empress Dowager Feng
people.known_for: Regent of Northern Wei who launched the equal-field system and major sinicizing reforms.
people.known_for_zh: 北魏文明太后，临朝称制，推行均田制等改革。

people.name: Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei
people.known_for: Moved the Northern Wei capital to Luoyang in 494 and pushed sweeping sinicization of the Xianbei.
people.known_for_zh: 迁都洛阳，推行汉化改革的北魏皇帝。

people.name: Zu Chongzhi
people.known_for: Mathematician-astronomer who computed π between 3.1415926 and 3.1415927 and devised the Daming calendar.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家、天文学家，将圆周率精确到小数点后七位，制《大明历》。

people.name: Tan Daoji
people.known_for: Leading Liu Song general famed for his stratagems, executed by a suspicious court.
people.known_for_zh: 刘宋名将，以计谋著称，后遭猜忌被杀，有“自毁长城”之叹。

people.name: Chen Qingzhi
people.known_for: Liang general whose small white-robed army marched to Luoyang winning dozens of battles in 529.
people.known_for_zh: 梁朝名将，率七千白袍军北伐直入洛阳。

people.name: Hou Jing
people.known_for: Defecting general whose rebellion sacked Jiankang and brought down Emperor Wu of Liang.
people.known_for_zh: 发动“侯景之乱”，攻陷建康，重创南朝的叛将。

people.name: Xiao Yan (Emperor Wu of Liang)
people.known_for: Long-reigning Liang emperor, devout Buddhist patron and man of letters, who died during Hou Jing's siege.
people.known_for_zh: 梁武帝，崇佛好文，在位近半世纪，死于侯景之乱。

people.name: Gao Huan
people.known_for: Warlord who dominated Eastern Wei from Jinyang and laid the foundation of Northern Qi.
people.known_for_zh: 东魏权臣，坐镇晋阳，奠定北齐基业。

people.name: Yuwen Tai
people.known_for: Paramount ruler of Western Wei who created the fubing militia system and founded Northern Zhou's power.
people.known_for_zh: 西魏权臣，创府兵制，奠定北周基业。

people.name: Hulü Guang
people.known_for: Northern Qi's greatest general, unbeaten against Northern Zhou, killed through enemy slander.
people.known_for_zh: 北齐名将，屡败北周，后因谗言被杀。

people.name: Gao Changgong (Prince of Lanling)
people.known_for: Handsome Northern Qi prince who fought masked; celebrated in the dance 'Prince of Lanling Enters Battle'.
people.known_for_zh: 北齐兰陵王，戴面具作战，《兰陵王入阵曲》即咏其事。

people.name: Lady Xian
people.known_for: Li chieftain who kept Lingnan peaceful and loyal through the Liang, Chen and Sui dynasties.
people.known_for_zh: 岭南俚族首领，历梁陈隋三朝保境安民。

people.name: Chen Baxian (Emperor Wu of Chen)
people.known_for: General who crushed Hou Jing's remnants and founded the Chen dynasty in 557.
people.known_for_zh: 平定侯景之乱余部，557年建立陈朝。

people.name: Xie He
people.known_for: Painter and critic whose Six Principles of Painting became the foundation of Chinese art theory.
people.known_for_zh: 画家、画论家，提出“绘画六法”。

people.name: Zhang Sengyou
people.known_for: Liang court painter of Buddhist murals, source of the idiom 'adding pupils to the painted dragon'.
people.known_for_zh: 梁代画家，擅佛画，“画龙点睛”典故主人公。

people.name: Shen Yue
people.known_for: Writer and historian who formulated the four tones and prosodic rules, and compiled the Book of Song.
people.known_for_zh: 文学家、史学家，提出“四声八病”，撰《宋书》。

people.name: Xie Tiao
people.known_for: Leading Yongming-style landscape poet, greatly admired later by Li Bai.
people.known_for_zh: 永明体代表诗人，山水诗清丽，深受李白推崇。

people.name: Jiang Yan
people.known_for: Poet of the 'Rhapsody on Parting', remembered in the idiom 'Jiang Lang has exhausted his talent'.
people.known_for_zh: 文学家，作《别赋》《恨赋》，“江郎才尽”典出于此。

people.name: Pei Songzhi
people.known_for: Historian whose rich annotations to the Records of the Three Kingdoms preserved many lost sources.
people.known_for_zh: 史学家，为《三国志》作注，保存大量史料。

works.title: Annotations to Records of the Three Kingdoms

people.name: Jia Sixie
people.known_for: Northern Wei official who wrote the Qimin Yaoshu, China's oldest complete agricultural treatise.
people.known_for_zh: 北魏农学家，著《齐民要术》。

people.name: Bodhidharma
people.place_zh: 嵩山少林寺（今河南登封）
people.known_for: Indian or Central Asian monk traditionally regarded as the founder of Chan (Zen) Buddhism in China.
people.known_for_zh: 来华高僧，被尊为中国禅宗初祖。

people.name: Yang Xuanzhi
people.known_for: Author of the Record of Buddhist Monasteries in Luoyang, a vivid memoir of the fallen capital.
people.known_for_zh: 著《洛阳伽蓝记》，记北魏洛阳佛寺盛衰。

works.title: Record of the Monasteries of Luoyang

people.name: Wei Shou
people.known_for: Northern Qi historian who compiled the Book of Wei, the official history of Northern Wei.
people.known_for_zh: 北齐史学家，撰《魏书》。

people.name: Yan Yanzhi
people.known_for: Ornate Liu Song poet, ranked with Xie Lingyun as the leading writers of the Yuanjia era.
people.known_for_zh: 刘宋诗人，与谢灵运并称“颜谢”。

people.name: Xu Ling
people.known_for: Liang-Chen court writer who compiled the love-poetry anthology New Songs from a Jade Terrace.
people.known_for_zh: 南朝文学家，编《玉台新咏》。

works.title: New Songs from a Jade Terrace

people.name: Song Yun
people.known_for: Northern Wei envoy who travelled to Gandhara in 518–522 and brought back Buddhist scriptures.
people.known_for_zh: 北魏使者，518年西行至乾陀罗求取佛经。

people.name: Kou Qianzhi
people.known_for: Daoist reformer whose Northern Celestial Masters became the state religion of Northern Wei.
people.known_for_zh: 道教改革家，创北天师道，被北魏奉为国教。

people.name: Su Chuo
people.known_for: Chief minister of Yuwen Tai who drafted Western Wei's Six Edicts of administrative reform.
people.known_for_zh: 西魏名臣，为宇文泰制定《六条诏书》。

people.name: He Chengtian
people.known_for: Astronomer and mathematician who created the Yuanjia calendar and an interpolation method.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家、数学家，制《元嘉历》。

people.name: Empress Dowager Hu
people.known_for: Regent of Northern Wei who built the great Yongning pagoda; drowned by Erzhu Rong.
people.known_for_zh: 北魏灵太后，临朝专政，建永宁寺塔，为尔朱荣沉河。

people.name: Erzhu Rong
people.known_for: Warlord who massacred the Northern Wei court at Heyin in 528 and dominated the state.
people.known_for_zh: 北魏权臣，制造“河阴之变”，挟持朝政。

people.name: Yuwen Yong (Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou)
people.known_for: Northern Zhou emperor who suppressed Buddhism and Daoism and conquered Northern Qi in 577.
people.known_for_zh: 北周武帝，灭佛道，577年灭北齐统一北方。

people.name: Zhiyi
people.known_for: Monk who founded the Tiantai school, the first major Chinese school of Buddhism.
people.known_for_zh: 高僧，创立天台宗，这是第一个由中国人创立的佛教宗派。

people.name: Yan Zhitui
people.known_for: Scholar whose family advice book is the classic of Chinese family teaching.
people.known_for_zh: 学者，所著《颜氏家训》是家训类著作的经典。

works.title: The Family Instructions of Master Yan

people.name: Zhan Ziqian
people.known_for: Painter of 'Spring Outing', often called the oldest surviving Chinese landscape scroll.
people.known_for_zh: 画家，传世《游春图》常被视为现存最早的山水画卷。

people.name: Xue Daoheng
people.known_for: The leading poet of the Sui court.
people.known_for_zh: 隋代最负盛名的诗人。
people.line_zh: 暗牖悬蛛网，空梁落燕泥。
people.line_en: Spiders hang webs at the dark window; swallows drop mud from the empty beam.

people.name: Yang Jian (Emperor Wen of Sui)
people.known_for: Founder of the Sui who reunified China in 589 and introduced the Three Departments and Six Ministries.
people.known_for_zh: 隋文帝，589年统一全国，创三省六部制。

people.name: Empress Dugu Qieluo
people.known_for: Influential empress of Emperor Wen, co-ruler in all but name, known as one of the 'Two Sages'.
people.known_for_zh: 隋文帝独孤皇后，参与朝政，与文帝并称“二圣”。

people.name: Gao Jiong
people.known_for: Chief minister who organised the conquest of Chen and the building of Daxing city.
people.known_for_zh: 隋朝名相，主持灭陈之役与营建大兴城。

people.name: Yang Su
people.known_for: Leading Sui general and minister who commanded the fleet against Chen and built the Renshou Palace.
people.known_for_zh: 隋朝名将权臣，领水军灭陈，督建仁寿宫。

people.name: Han Qinhu
people.known_for: Sui general who captured Jiankang and the last Chen emperor in 589.
people.known_for_zh: 隋朝名将，589年率先攻入建康，俘陈后主。

people.name: Heruo Bi
people.known_for: Sui general who crossed the Yangtze to defeat the Chen army in the 589 conquest.
people.known_for_zh: 隋朝名将，渡江大败陈军，平陈功臣。

people.name: Pei Ju
people.known_for: Sui official who managed Silk Road trade at Zhangye and wrote the Illustrated Records of the Western Regions.
people.known_for_zh: 隋臣，主持张掖互市，著《西域图记》。

works.title: Illustrated Records of the Western Regions

people.name: Jizang
people.known_for: Monk and systematiser of the Three Treatise (Sanlun) school of Madhyamaka Buddhism.
people.known_for_zh: 三论宗集大成者。

people.name: Liu Zhuo
people.known_for: Astronomer whose Huangji calendar first used quadratic interpolation for solar motion.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家，制《皇极历》，首创二次内插法。

capitals.name: Pyongyang
capitals.note: King Jangsu moved the capital south from Gungnae.
capitals.note_zh: 长寿王从国内城南迁平壤。

capitals.name: Luoyang
capitals.note: Emperor Xiaowen moved the capital from Pingcheng.
capitals.note_zh: 孝文帝自平城迁都洛阳。

capitals.name: Gaochang
capitals.note: Kingdom of the Qu family in the Turpan basin.
capitals.note_zh: 麴氏高昌王国，位于吐鲁番盆地。

capitals.name: Jiangling
capitals.note: Emperor Yuan ruled from here until Western Wei took it.
capitals.note_zh: 梁元帝定都于此，554年被西魏攻破。
